## Problem

What's the problem or limitation you're running into? Describe it independently
of any specific solution.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen? If you have a specific approach in mind, describe
it here.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps us understand the request: links, screenshots, related
issues, or which plugin/area this touches.
